minutes.headline: Committee approved the capital plan with the wheelchair lift moved to FY22, and approved the five-year district plan.
minutes.summary: The committee heard the superintendent's start-of-year report, including enrollment numbers and a new school resource officer. It reviewed the FY19 to FY28 capital plan, moved the shade structures to the operating budget, and approved the plan with changes. It also appointed a Charter Review representative, approved the five-year district improvement plan, and discussed the athletic advisory council, waivers and the calendar workshop.

what_happened.line: The committee moved to approve the FY19 to FY28 capital plan with changes, including the wheelchair lift moved to FY22; the vote result was not audible.
Shade structures moved from the capital plan to the operating budget, with school maintenance staff to install them.
The committee approved Katie Adams as its representative to the Charter Review Committee.
A motion to approve the five-year district improvement plan was made; the vote result was not audible in the recording.
The Turkey Hill asbestos abatement finished late, and liquidated damages will be figured into the final billing.

why_it_matters: Moving the shade structures into the operating budget puts that cost on the yearly school budget, mostly taxes, instead of the multi-year capital plan.
Shifting the wheelchair lift to FY22 changes which year its cost is carried, and the capital plan sets the schedule for school building work that residents may be asked to fund.
